2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch modifies the page_counter_try_charge function to be aware of stock, allowing it to consume stock transparently while preserving existing semantics. Two new parameters are added: may_batch and nr_charged. The first parameter preserves the behavior in !allow_spinning scenarios, where charges are made as quickly as possible without evicting other stock slots. The second parameter reflects the size of a successful hierarchy charge, used for memory.high accounting heuristics.
